headline: Peruvian Mining Contractor JRC Targets $450 Million 2026 Revenue
summary: Peruvian contractor JRC projects 2026 revenue of $450 million, supported by expanding gold and silver mining operations in Mexico. The firm is actively seeking new mine acquisitions across Latin America.
why: JRC is a major South American underground mining services provider operating across Latin America's precious metals sector.

impacts.name: JRC
impacts.why: Expanding mining operations in Mexico drive JRC's projected revenue to $450 million.
